log.text:
On a Student visa in England, you may be able to get 80 schemes and services. 8 of them have an amount. 13 others are not open to you because of your visa condition.

Here are 3 to look at first. Council Tax student exemption (Class N): £1,800 (typical annual saving). British Gas Energy Trust grants: £1,700 (up to, one-off). University hardship fund: £1,400 (typical amount).

All the amounts together come to £8,464. That is the potential, if all approved. See every scheme in Benefits.

16-25 Railcard: 1/3 off rail fares. You may be able to get this.

It could be worth £212 (average yearly saving). Time to apply: 10 minutes. Decision: instant for digital.

You will need: a passport from any country, or other accepted ID; a digital photo; and payment card.
sug: What does no recourse to public funds mean?

log.text:
18+ Student Oyster photocard: 30% off London travelcards. You may be able to get this.

Landit lists it as: 30% off season tickets. Time to apply: 20 minutes. Decision: up to 2 weeks for the card.

You will need: your university enrolment details, a digital photo and your London term-time address.
sug: What does no recourse to public funds mean?

log.text:
University hardship fund: non-repayable student grants. You may be able to get this.

It could be worth £1,400 (typical amount). Time to apply: 1 to 2 hours. Decision: typically 2 to 6 weeks.

You will need: 3 months of bank statements; a budget: income in, essential costs out; evidence of what changed (job loss, family emergency, unexpected bill); and your enrolment details.
sug: What does no recourse to public funds mean?

log.text:
GP registration: free NHS primary care. You may be able to get this.

Landit lists it as: free care. Time to apply: 15 minutes. Decision: usually same day to 2 weeks.

Nothing is legally required.

Landit lists it as: up to 100% off. Time to apply: 30 minutes. Decision: 2 to 8 weeks.

Food banks (Trussell + independents): emergency food, referral-based. You may be able to get this.

Landit lists it as: 3-day parcels. Time to apply: one phone call. Decision: same day.

You may also need: referral voucher from a partner agency (Citizens Advice, school, GP, council). Nothing. No ID or immigration check.

16-25 Railcard: 1/3 off rail fares. It could be worth £212 (average yearly saving). 18+ Student Oyster photocard: 30% off London travelcards. National bus fare cap: single fares capped at £3 to 31 December 2026, then £2 for the whole of 2027.

See them all in Benefits.

log.text:
Public funds are a fixed list in paragraph 6.2 of the Immigration Rules. If a scheme is not on that list, the no recourse to public funds condition does not apply to it. Only the scheme's own rules matter.

Your visa has this condition. Landit set aside 13 schemes that are public funds or need one, and shows 80 that your condition does not touch.

If you are not sure about your conditions, free regulated immigration advice can help.

Tracking keeps the schemes you are working on in your sidebar. Open a scheme in Benefits and choose Track.

For each one, you can tick the documents you have, and note where you are: Not started, Applied, Approved or Turned down.

You are tracking 2: University hardship fund (applied) and Council Tax student exemption (Class N) (not started).
